# Copy-rules allow-list (read by .github/scripts/check-copy.mjs, CONTRACT §4.8 / §7 items 4 and 13).
#
# Banned in user-visible text (case-insensitive, whole word): boost, optimize/optimise,
# speed up, free RAM, junk, trash, purge (as a button/CTA or heading), deep purge,
# outdated, and (since 1.2) agent. Checked in src-frontend/**/*.ts and *.tsx; "agent" is
# also checked in the string literals of src-tauri/src/**/*.rs. Identifiers in code and
# literals without spaces ("agent-status", "nexum-agent.exe") are exempt automatically.
#
# Format, one entry per line, followed by a comment saying why it is acceptable:
#   <repo-relative path>:<line>           allow every banned word on that line
#   <repo-relative path>:<line>:<word>    allow one banned word on that line
# Example:
#   src-frontend/components/system/CpuTab.tsx:40:boost   # AMD "Precision Boost" is a CPU feature name
#
# "agent" has NO exceptions (CONTRACT §7 item 13): a line entry does not excuse it, and a
# word entry naming it fails the check. Say what the person sees instead (CONTRACT §4.8.1).
